svg.title: How a document moves through Bikeshed
svg.desc: 1 Publish: upload HTML, Markdown or a zip, or ask your agent to publish it. 2 Share: private until you share it. 3 Review: comments stay on the exact words, and suggested edits wait for a decision. 4 Revise: you or your agent answer each comment, then publish the next version, which goes back for review. Every version keeps its own comments.
